title: EAC Common Market Protocol
summary: Free movement of persons, workers, services and capital among Partner States.

title: EAC Customs Union Protocol
summary: Common external tariff, elimination of internal tariffs, and rules of origin within the Community.

title: EAC Monetary Union Protocol
summary: Framework for eventual single currency, macroeconomic convergence criteria and East African Central Bank roadmap.

title: East African Community Court of Justice — Rules of Procedure
summary: Procedure for references from national courts, community actions, and staff disputes before the EACJ.

title: EAC Elimination of Non-Tariff Barriers Act
summary: Provides for identification, monitoring and elimination of NTBs to trade within the Community.

title: Inter-University Council for East Africa Convention
summary: Harmonisation of higher education standards and mutual recognition of qualifications.

title: EAC Treaty — Free Movement of Persons
summary: Partner States undertake to adopt measures to achieve free movement of persons who are citizens of the Partner States.

title: East African Standards — Model Law on Competition
summary: Model competition framework intended for domestication by Partner States including Kenya's Competition Act alignment.

title: EAC Health Protocol
summary: Cooperation on disease surveillance, medicines regulation and health systems strengthening.

title: EAC Disaster Risk Management Act
summary: Framework for prevention, preparedness and response to disasters across Partner States.

title: EAC Trade and Investment Framework
summary: Guidelines for investment climate reform and cross-border trade facilitation.

title: EAC Conflict Management Protocol
summary: Peace and security architecture for mediation and conflict early warning in the region.
